card.name: Linking words in military-themed passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (for, of, and, in) inside passages about armies, militias, defense or war, where a military term is likely to come next.

modes.label: Militia clause wording
modes.description: Commas and small words inside the constitutional text about organizing and arming the Militia.
modes.example: , §8, clause 16 grants to Congress the power to provide for organizing, arming, and disciplining, the Militia, and<< for>> governing such Part of them as may be

modes.label: Defense and weapons phrases
modes.description: The word "of" after needs, use or possession in text about defense or weapons.
modes.example: castle design began to lay more stress on the comforts of life and less on the needs<< of>> defense. Contrary to the image portrayed

modes.label: Army and officer history
modes.description: Linking words or the word military itself in accounts of officers, courts and staff duties.
modes.example: was convicted of treason by a military court for passing on<< military>> secrets to the Germans.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting military and defense words next, and away from unrelated words like poll.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in text about armies and defense, when a military term is likely to follow.
